name: Dead Bug
description: A core exercise on your back: arms up and knees over hips, lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor while your back stays flat.

source.title: Supine Dead Bug (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie on your back, arms pointing at the ceiling, knees bent at 90° over your hips.
cues: Press your lower back into the floor the whole time.
Move slowly and breathe out as you extend.
Only lower as far as you can keep your back down.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Arms up, knees up
keyframes.cue: Knees over hips, arms to the ceiling.

keyframes.name: Extend
keyframes.cue: Lower your right arm overhead and straighten your left leg.
